shortDescription: Sigiriya to the south coast in ten days - tea hills, safari, and beach with 4 STAR hotels and a private driver.
overview:
A classic ten-day private journey through Sri Lanka's most loved regions. From Sigiriya and Pidurangala to Kandy, Nuwara Eliya tea country, Horton Plains, and a scenic Ella train ride, then Yala safari and the south coast.
Mirissa whale watching, Galle Fort, Bentota, and Kalutara round out the route, with half-board stays at hand-picked hotels so you can travel deeper without daily logistics stress.

seo.metaTitle: 10 дней Classic Ceylon с отелями 4 ЗВЕЗДЫ и частным трансфером | Hai Sri Lanka
seo.metaDescription: Private 9 ночей / 10 дней Sri Lanka tour: Sigiriya, Kandy, Nuwara Eliya, Ella, Yala, Mirissa, Galle, and Kalutara with half-board hotels.

itinerary.title: Airport / Hotel – Sigiriya
itinerary.description: Travel inland to Sigiriya, climb Lion Rock, and enjoy a village tour before settling in for the night.

itinerary.title: Sigiriya
itinerary.description: Sunrise views from Pidurangala, an elephant safari at Minneriya, Kaudulla, or Hurulu Eco Park, and an optional Ayurveda massage.

itinerary.title: Sigiriya – Kandy
itinerary.description: Leave the Triangle via Dambulla Cave Temple, pause at a spice garden and gem museum, then enjoy a Kandyan cultural dance in the evening.

itinerary.title: Kandy – Nuwara Eliya
itinerary.description: Morning at the Temple of the Tooth Relic, then climb toward the tea hills with Ambuluwawa Tower, a plantation and factory visit, and a Nuwara Eliya city tour.

itinerary.title: Nuwara Eliya – Ella
itinerary.description: Early trek in Horton Plains National Park, then continue to Ella by scenic train through the hills.

itinerary.title: Ella
itinerary.description: A relaxed Ella day — light city tour in the morning, then free time to unwind in the hills.

itinerary.title: Ella – Yala
itinerary.description: Descend toward the plains with a stop at Ravana Falls, then an afternoon or evening safari in Yala National Park.

itinerary.title: Yala – Mirissa
itinerary.description: Coastal day at Mirissa — whale watching, snorkeling with whales or sea turtles, kayaking, and beach time.

itinerary.title: Mirissa – Galle – Kalutara
itinerary.description: Explore Galle Fort, visit a turtle hatchery, and enjoy a Bentota boat ride before overnighting in Kalutara.

itinerary.title: Kalutara
itinerary.description: A Colombo city tour timed to your schedule, then private drop-off to the airport or your hotel.

faqs.question: Are hotels on half board?
faqs.answer: Yes. Overnight stays are on an HB (half-board) basis — breakfast and dinner included — at the named hotels or similar.

faqs.question: Is whale watching seasonal?
faqs.answer: Mirissa whale watching is typically best from November to April. Outside peak season we suggest snorkeling with sea turtles or other coastal alternatives.

faqs.question: Can the itinerary be customized?
faqs.answer: Yes. We tailor pace, hotels, and experiences to your preferences.
